title: Time asked, order passed that day

scenes.dialogue: You ask the tax department for time to file documents, until a certain date. The order comes on that very date, with no word on your request. Is that fair?
A company faced exactly this. It also had a remedy of appeal. So would the Delhi High Court hear its writ petition, or send it off to appeal?
